title: Settings
description: V3 (Agents window) on an organization-managed install. 27 real policy-capable settings are set by a simulated organization. GitHub Copilot policies cover agent mode, registry-only MCP access, no global auto-approve, session sync off, approved plugins, hooks, marketplace and GitHub environments. Device management (macOS profile / Group Policy / policy.json) covers agent sandboxing with an allow-listed network, terminal auto-approve off, Claude/Codex harnesses off, OTel export to the org collector, browser chat tools, allowed extensions, update mode and telemetry. A new "Managed" page at the bottom of the sidebar lists every managed setting with its source; elsewhere rows show a clickable "Managed by your organization" badge that leads there.
